limits: Locks and journal are per Node process, not cross-process or durable.
A replay acknowledges the historical operation; it is not a read of current file state.
All cooperating file mutators share locks, but raw write_file has no caller-supplied version or operation ID.
Journal retains at most 1024 IDs per process and refuses new IDs at capacity without eviction.
Final hash/metadata check is not atomically coupled to OS rename; external-writer races remain.
Permissions are checked by existing dispatcher before execution/replay; direct Workspace embedding is not an authorization boundary.
Previous user E0/E1 evidence remains tied to the earlier code, not automatically to this update.
